parameters.query:
with recent as (
  select * from feedback
  where received_at > now() - make_interval(days => $1::int)
),
by_category as (
  select category, count(*) as anzahl from recent group by category
),
by_priority as (
  select priority, count(*) as anzahl from recent group by priority
),
by_category_priority as (
  select category, priority, count(*) as anzahl from recent group by category, priority
),
per_day as (
  select date_trunc('day', received_at)::date as tag, count(*) as anzahl from recent group by 1
)
select json_build_object(
  'zeitraum_tage',         $1::int,
  'gesamt',                (select count(*) from recent),
  'pro_tag_durchschnitt',  (select round(count(*)::numeric / $1::int, 2) from recent),
  'haeufigste_kategorie',  (select category from by_category order by anzahl desc, category limit 1),
  'nach_kategorie',        coalesce((select json_object_agg(category, anzahl) from by_category), '{}'::json),
  'nach_prioritaet',       coalesce((select json_object_agg(priority, anzahl) from by_priority), '{}'::json),
  'nach_kategorie_und_prioritaet', coalesce((
      select json_agg(json_build_object('category', category, 'priority', priority, 'anzahl', anzahl)
                      order by anzahl desc, category, priority)
      from by_category_priority), '[]'::json),
  'pro_tag',               coalesce((select json_agg(json_build_object('tag', tag, 'anzahl', anzahl) order by tag)
                                     from per_day), '[]'::json),
  'klassifizierung_fehlgeschlagen', (select count(*) from recent where parse_error),
  'tokens', json_build_object(
      'input',  (select coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) from recent),
      'output', (select coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) from recent))
) as stats;
